game.title: Yakuza 0
game.blurb: Crime action-adventure set in 1988 Tokyo, from Ryu ga Gotoku Studio (published by SEGA), released 2015-03-12. RAWG average playtime: 8 hours (far under a full run). Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Kazuma Kiryu and Goro Majima are pulled into a yakuza power struggle; Kiryu is framed over the "Empty Lot". Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Real Estate Royale
chapters.summary: Kiryu's property business: buying up areas and the most expensive property.

chapters.title: Cabaret Club Czar
chapters.summary: Running the cabaret club business, fans and hostesses.

chapters.title: Substories
chapters.summary: The many side stories around the city.

chapters.title: Nightlife and Minigames
chapters.summary: Disco, the telephone club, Pocket Circuit, catfights, Dream Machines, telephone cards and spending money.

chapters.title: Combat, Styles and Training
chapters.summary: Abilities, fighting styles, masters, Mr. Shakedown, weapons and gear, and Endless Rout.

chapters.title: Legend Difficulty and Completion
chapters.summary: Legend difficulty, the Completion List and every achievement.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has the guide at completion stage 0. Its Table of Contents links 16 chapter pages and a Finale; only Chapter 1, Chapter 3 and Finale are written (about 1,100 to 1,800 characters each), plus Walkthrough, Substories (about 6,900), Completion List (about 6,400), Gameplay and Controls. That is not a real walkthrough, so it was not recorded in sw-structure.json and not used; Substories and Completion List could seed checklists later. StrategyWiki also lists Nintendo Switch 2 and a 2025 category, which RAWG does not show. yakuza.fandom.com answers the API, with about 105 linked pages, including "Cabaret Club Czar"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The only Steam app found in the app list is "Yakuza 0 Director's Cut" (2988580), so that edition is used; its schema calls the app "Gelande" (an internal codename) and it has 55 achievements. RAWG's entry is the 2015 game (id 492). 23 of 55 are hidden and sit in the main story chapter; several have low unlock rates ("Smooth Criminal", "They Won't Mind", "Just Beat It", "Amon Defeated" at 2 to 7 percent) and are probably side content or substories.
